card.name: Malay and Dutch/German text words
card.fires_on: Words in non-English text, mainly Malay, also Dutch, German or Latin-like medical terms. It fires on common words such as kepada, Een, satu, or on word parts in the middle of such words.

modes.label: Malay words
modes.description: Common Malay words or word parts in Malay passages about Malays, China and India.
modes.example: Melayu memegang islam menyebabkan mereka menumpu<< kepada>> Cina dan India.

modes.description: Words or word parts in old Dutch or German titles and quotes.

modes.label: Partway through foreign terms
modes.description: Middle of a long foreign or Latin-style word, including a Spanish label.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like Kon, Kom and Kal, which fit non-English words.
